title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant

Norwich

Part Time 25-30 hours per week

£28,000-£30,000 FTE

Flexible Working

We are currently recruiting for a Finance Assistant to join a friendly and established team in Norwich. This is a part-time opportunity offering flexibility around working hours, making it a great option for someone looking for a better work-life balance.

The role will provide support across a range of day-to-day finance duties, with a particular focus on banking, invoicing and customer queries.

The Role

As Finance Assistant, your responsibilities will include:
- Completing regular bank reconciliations
- Processing and raising customer invoices
- Allocating payments and maintaining accurate financial records
- Dealing with customer queries by telephone and email
- Investigating and resolving any payment or invoice queries
- Supporting the wider finance team with day-to-day accounting duties
- Assisting with general finance administration as required

About You

We are looking for someone with previous relevant finance experience who is confident working across a range of transactional finance duties.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience within a finance or accounts environment
- Experience of bank reconciliations and invoicing
- Strong attention to detail and good numerical accuracy
- Excellent communication skills
- A confident and professional telephone manner
- The ability to deal with customer queries calmly and effectively
- Good organisation skills and the ability to manage your own workload
- A positive, helpful and team-focused approach

What's on Offer?
- Part-time hours of 25-30 hours per week
- £28,000-£30,000 FTE
- Flexible working arrangements
- Norwich location
- A varied finance role within a supportive team

If you're an experienced finance professional looking for a part-time opportunity in Norwich, we'd love to hear from you.

Call Rebecca on or email your CV to

title: Accounts Office Administrator
company: H Smith & Sons (Honingham) Ltd. - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Office Administrator

Job Type: Full Time / Part Time 5 days per week, Permanent (Flexible Hours)

Location: Honingham, Norfolk

Working Hours: Monday - Friday

Salary: Competitive DOE

Established in 1919, H Smith & Sons of Honingham is a long-established and well-respected family run Building Contractor.

Offering a competitive salary and a friendly working environment, we have an exciting opportunity for a Full Time or Part Time numerical and organised Accounts and General Office Administrator to join our team in Honingham, Norwich.

The Role - Accounts and General Office Administrator:

We have an excellent opportunity for an Accounts and General Office Administrator to work Full or Part Time to complete accounts processing, customer care functions, and admin support for both head office and site base staff.

We will consider full time or 5 days per week part time for this position.

Role Responsibilities - Accounts and General Office Administrator:

Accounts:
- Process purchase ledger, sub-contractor ledger, sales ledger and rent ledger invoices onto the accounts system.
- Provide accounts support to our Quantity Surveyors.
- Match purchase invoices to purchase orders, and reconcile any discrepancies.
- Send sales invoices and statements to customers.

Customer Care & Admin Support:
- Act as the first point of contact for visitors to Head Office, callers telephoning the general switchboard numbers, and pass on messages as required.
- Submit site registration forms.
- Maintain the company contact address book.
- Load and update maintenance items into our helpdesk software.
- Maintain the contract files, and other records/files as directed, filing new documents when received.
- Provide holiday and sickness cover for the other part time Accounts Admin Support.

Person Specification - Accounts and General Office Administrator:
- Experience in a similar Accounts Admin Support role.
- A personable, enthusiastic and accommodating individual.
- Self-motivated with excellent attention to detail.
- Highly numerical with good problem-solving skills.
- Able to work in a methodical manner.
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.
- A team player, also able to work on own initiative.
- Working knowledge of Redsky IT Summit accounts package is desirable.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
Sales Administrator

Location: King's Lynn Area
Salary: £25,000 - £26,000
Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time

The Opportunity

A well-established automotive business is seeking an organised and motivated Sales Administrator to join its busy dealership team. This is an excellent opportunity for an individual looking to develop a long-term career within the automotive sector, with full training and ongoing support provided.

Working within a fast-paced environment, you will support the sales function through accurate administration, customer service and coordination of vehicle sales processes.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Administration
- Process vehicle sales orders accurately and efficiently.
- Prepare customer and vehicle documentation.
- Assist with vehicle registrations and invoicing.
- Maintain accurate vehicle stock records and sales databases.
- Provide administrative support to the sales team.
- Liaise with customers, finance providers and external suppliers.
- Ensure all documentation is completed in line with company procedures and compliance requirements.

General Administration
- Handle telephone and email enquiries professionally.
- Welcome customers and provide a high standard of customer service.
- Maintain organised filing systems and office records.
- Support colleagues with day-to-day administrative tasks.

Candidate Requirements

The successful candidate will:
- Have previous administration experience.
- Ideally possess at least 1 year of vehicle sales administration experience.
- Demonstrate strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Be confident using Microsoft Office and computer systems.
- Have strong communication and customer service skills.
- Possess good numeracy and literacy abilities.
- Be able to manage workloads effectively and prioritise tasks.
- Work well as part of a team.
- Display a positive, reliable and professional attitude.

Automotive industry experience is advantageous but not essential, as full training can be provided.

What's on Offer
- £25,000 - £26,000 basic salary.
- Full training and ongoing development.
- Career progression opportunities.
- Company pension scheme.
- Employee discount scheme.
- Cycle to work scheme.
- Enhanced maternity and paternity benefits.
- Life insurance.
- Referral programme.
- Sick pay.
- Additional annual leave benefits.
- Free on-site parking.
- Supportive and friendly working environment.

Additional Information
- Full-time, permanent position.
- Office-based role.
- Candidates must be able to commute to the King's Lynn area.
- Employment will be subject to satisfactory pre-employment checks, including references and background screening where applicable.

title: Finance Assistant
company: Big Sky Additions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are recruiting a Finance Assistant to join a busy and supportive finance team based in Norwich.

This is a great opportunity for someone with Purchase Ledger or Accounts Payable experience who is looking for a varied role offering responsibility for their own supplier accounts and exposure to wider finance processes.

You'll work closely with colleagues across finance, purchasing and operational teams, combining day-to-day invoice processing with reconciliations, subcontractor payments and query resolution.

What You'll Be Doing
- Processing supplier invoices and credit notes.
- Matching invoices against purchase orders and goods received.
- Coding costs accurately to contracts and relevant cost codes.
- Managing your own portfolio of supplier accounts.
- Completing supplier statement reconciliations and investigating discrepancies.
- Resolving invoice and payment queries with suppliers and internal teams.
- Reviewing and processing subcontractor payment information.
- Preparing subcontractor payment runs.
- Ensuring invoices and payments meet internal controls and procedures.
- Supporting the wider finance team when required.

What We're Looking For

You'll already have experience within Purchase Ledger, Accounts Payable or a similar finance role and be comfortable working in a busy environment.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Good experience processing invoices and reconciling supplier accounts.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- The ability to organise and prioritise your own workload.
- Confidence investigating discrepancies and resolving queries.
- Good communication skills when dealing with suppliers and colleagues.
- Competence with Excel and accounting systems.
- A proactive approach and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Knowledge of CIS, VAT or subcontractor payments would be advantageous, as would experience within construction or another project-led environment.

What's on Offer?

A varied Finance Assistant position within a friendly and experienced team, offering the opportunity to take ownership of your workload and broaden your accounts experience.

Please apply online or contact Justin Murray at Big Sky Additions for a confidential chat.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
ACCOUNTS ASSISTANT
NORWICH (HYBRID AFTER PROBATION)
UP TO £32,500

THE OPPORTUNITY:

We're recruiting on behalf of an established retail business that is looking for an Accounts Assistant to join its busy finance team. This newly created position follows continued business growth and internal promotions.

Working closely with the Management Accountants, you'll support the preparation of monthly management accounts and manufacturer reporting, while providing financial information to senior managers and stakeholders.

This is an opportunity for someone with experience in an accounts department who is keen to develop their management accounting skills and take on a varied role within a supportive team.

THE ACCOUNTS ASSISTANT ROLE:
- Supporting the preparation of monthly management accounts.
- Assisting with month-end processes, including accruals and prepayments.
- Completing balance sheet reconciliations, providing commentary and following up outstanding items.
- Authorising daily payments in line with company procedures.
- Processing manufacturer bonuses on a weekly basis.
- Monitoring outstanding debts, chasing overdue balances and reporting on ageing debt.
- Responding to queries from management and explaining information within the management accounts.
- Supporting stock takes, performing variance analysis and investigating causes.
- Working alongside Senior Accountants to identify improvements to financial processes and operational procedures.
- Highlighting discrepancies, financial control concerns and any suspected fraudulent activity.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting documentation in accordance with company procedures and legal requirements.

THE PERSON:
- AAT Level 3 qualified or equivalent; candidates qualified by experience will also be considered.
- Previous experience within a busy accounts department.
- Confident using Microsoft Office packages, including Excel.
- Knowledge of Pinnacle DMS would be advantageous but is not essential.
- Previous retail or motor trade experience would be beneficial but is not essential.

title: Client Bookkeeper
description:
Client Bookkeeper

Norwich £28,000 to £34,000 Full-time, permanent Hybrid after probation

If you're the bookkeeper people come to when something doesn't add up, and you'd rather build smarter ways of working than do things the way they've always been done, read on.

This is a bookkeeping and client-focused role with a modern Norwich practice. You'll keep the bookkeeping running smoothly, review other people's work and produce VAT, MTD and possibly management accounts, with AI tools to help you work faster.

THE FIRM

An independent, cloud-based accountancy practice in Norwich with a clear purpose: to make accounting a genuine partnership for small businesses, not a black box. The client base is varied and interesting, from owner-managed businesses and entrepreneurs to charities and social enterprises.

They use AI tools properly (with a human always checking the output), the leadership team are serious about training and technical standards, and the culture puts wellbeing and development front and centre.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
- Running the day-to-day bookkeeping and reporting planner, so work flows and deadlines are hit
- Reviewing junior colleagues' bookkeeping, spotting patterns and training errors out rather than quietly fixing them
- Preparing and submitting VAT and MTD returns
- Processing and reviewing bookkeeping in Dext, FreeAgent, Xero and QuickBooks
- Using AI to speed up file reviews, draft client queries and pull insight from the numbers
- Spotting bottlenecks and clearing them, rather than letting queries sit

WHO THIS WILL SUIT
- AAT or ICB qualified (MICB or FICB), or strong QBE
- At least 3 years' multi-client experience in UK accountancy practice
- Confident with VAT, MTD and management accounts
- Genuinely tech-savvy and keen on AI and automation
- Unafraid of change and happy to rethink how things are done
- Someone who drives work forward and enjoys helping others improve

WHAT'S ON OFFER
- £28,000 to £34,000, depending on experience
- Hybrid working once you've passed probation
- Fully funded private healthcare, an Employee Assistance Programme and trained Mental Health First Aiders
- Profit-share bonus and pension
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Support with further study if you want to progress
- A green, easy-to-reach office with a cycle to work scheme

INTERESTED?

Give me a call or send your CV for a confidential chat. Nothing goes to the firm without your say-so.

Know someone who'd be perfect for this? If I place them, I'll send you £250 in John Lewis vouchers as a thank you.

title: Supply Chain & Procurement Coordinator
description:
Job Description - Supply Chain & Procurement Role
Location: Great Yarmouth
Salary - dependant on experience

As a Supply Chain & Procurement Coordinator / Supply Chain & Procurement Specialist will be responsible for quoting parts required by customers. They manage the daily receipt of local and international supplies, national distribution, and assess customer needs. Operating within the Customer Service Department, the team maintains external contacts with customers and third parties involved in supply processes. This role is based in Great Yarmouth.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities of Supply Chain & Procurement Coordinator / Supply Chain & Procurement Specialist

Lead and coordinate all supply chain activities.

Define sourcing, production, storage, and distribution strategies.

Monitor KPIs such as OTIF (On Time In Full), logistics cost, inventory turnover, and lead times.

Manage purchasing operations and ensure compliance with procurement cycles.

Negotiate contracts and framework agreements with suppliers.

Control budgets and spending policies & Execute strategic and tactical purchasing.

Negotiate prices, lead times, and terms.

Analyse market trends and supply risks.

Process purchase orders and follow up on deliveries.

Support documentation, tenders, and invoice control.

Forecast product and raw material demand.

Prepare supply and production plans based on forecasts and stock levels.

Coordinate with purchasing and production to avoid stockouts or overstock.

Manage domestic and international transportation and distribution.

Coordinate with freight forwarders, carriers, and customs agents.

Ensure compliance with regulations.

Oversee warehouse operations.

Maintain accurate and organized inventories, and perform cycle counts and annual stocktakes.

Quote products related to services, aiming for the best availability using company tools.

Respond quickly to requests for quotations.

Identify market developments and new technologies that could add value.

Stay informed on relevant laws and regulations.

Qualifications and Requirements Supply Chain & Procurement Coordinator / Supply Chain & Procurement Specialist

Proven experience in a similar role, experience within a marine environment preferred

Proficient in MS Office, CRM, and ERP systems.

Strong knowledge of procurement processes and supply chain management.

Understanding of Incoterms, customs procedures, and international trade regulations.

Inventory management and warehouse operations expertise.

Knowledge of demand planning, forecasting, and stock optimization.

Contract negotiation and vendor management experience.

Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:

Strong decision-making skills under pressure.

Excellent written and verbal communication in English (additional languages a plus).

Negotiation and persuasion abilities.

High attention to detail and accuracy.

Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects.

Flexible and proactive in adapting to market and business changes.

Able to travel as required,

Able to travel to the role based in Great Yarmouth daily

title: Receptionist
description: Are you an enthusiastic, organised and compassionate person who enjoys helping people and working as part of a busy team? The Park Surgery is looking for a Medical Receptionist to join our established reception team for 30 to 37 hours per week, with a salary of £25,272 FTE. As one of the first people our patients meet or speak to, you will play a vital role in creating a welcoming experience and helping patients access the right care. This is a varied position combining reception, care navigation, appointment management and general administration. You will work closely with clinical, administrative and external colleagues, using SystmOne and digital services to keep information accurate and services running smoothly. We are committed to high-quality, efficient, personal and responsive care, and we value kindness, teamwork, clear communication and continuous improvement. You will receive a full induction, mandatory training and ongoing support to develop your skills. If you are calm under pressure, confident using IT, committed to confidentiality and able to communicate with empathy and professionalism, we would be pleased to hear from you. As a Medical Receptionist, you will be a key member of our general practice team and often the first point of contact for patients. You will welcome patients, manage arrivals and enquiries, answer telephone and online requests, maintain the appointment system and support triage administration. Using approved protocols, you will care-navigate and signpost patients to the most appropriate service, recognising and escalating urgent concerns without providing clinical advice. You will accurately update patient records, process registrations, scan correspondence, action emails, support repeat-prescription workflows and direct requests such as subject access, insurance, solicitor and DVLA enquiries to the appropriate team. You will also support clinicians and colleagues with general administration, recalls, vaccination clinics and service-improvement work. The role requires excellent communication, confidentiality, accuracy, empathy and confidence when managing sensitive or difficult situations, alongside compliance with safeguarding, information governance, infection-control and health-and-safety procedures. Primary key responsibilities The following are the core responsibilities of a Receptionist in delivering health services: a. Accurately detail information on patients records within the clinical system b. Maintain and monitor the practice appointment system c. Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments d. Assist with total triage administration e. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with callers requests appropriately f. Signpost patients to the correct service g. Initiate contact with and respond to requests from patients, team members and external agencies h. Photocopy documentation as required i. Enter data for new and temporary registrations and relevant patient information as required j. Input data into patients healthcare records as necessary k. Direct requests for information, including DSARs, insurance or solicitors letters and DVLA forms, to the administrative team l. Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner m. Carry out system searches as requested n. Support all clinical staff with general administrative tasks as requested o. Undertake a broad spectrum of administrative duties commensurate with the role p. Be an integral part of the general practice team q. Act as a chaperone as required r. Be aware of duties and responsibilities under current legislation and adhere to practice policies and procedures on safeguarding adults and children s. Support the delivery of enhanced services and other service requirements t. Undertake all mandatory training and induction programmes u. Contribute to and embrace the spectrum of clinical governance v. Maintain a clean, tidy and effective working area at all times w. Attend a formal appraisal with the line manager at least every 12 months; progress against agreed performance and training objectives will be reviewed regularly so that new objectives can be agreed There may be, on occasion, a requirement to carry out other tasks. This will depend on factors such as workload and staffing levels. Wider responsibilities In addition to the primary responsibilities, the Receptionist has the following wider responsibilities: a. Support administrative staff, providing cover during staff absences b. Action incoming emails and correspondence as necessary c. Scan patient-related documentation and attach scanned documents to patients healthcare records d. Participate in local initiatives to enhance service delivery and patient care e. Support the management of repeat prescriptions, ensuring they are processed accurately and efficiently f. Support and participate in shared learning g. Welcome patients, manage arrivals, confirm demographic and contact details, and respond appropriately to reception and waiting-area enquiries h. Undertake care navigation using approved practice protocols, without providing clinical advice, and recognise and escalate urgent or concerning presentations promptly i. Respond professionally to concerns and difficult situations, use appropriate de-escalation techniques, and refer formal complaints in line with practice procedure j. Follow infection prevention and control guidance and practice procedures for suspected communicable diseases k. Understand and follow emergency, evacuation and business-continuity procedures and maintain required basic life-support training l. Comply with UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, Caldicott principles and practice information-governance procedures, including appropriate identity verification before disclosing information m. Identify communication and accessibility needs, arrange interpreters where required, and support reasonable adjustments for disability, sensory loss or language barriers n. Support patients to use online services, including the NHS App and online access routes, and promote digital inclusion while offering appropriate alternatives o. Maintain accurate patient records, including contact details, preferred communication methods, consent information and reasonable-adjustment requirements p. Handle payments, receipts and private-service administration accurately where this forms part of practice procedures q. Complete opening and closing duties where rostered, ensuring reception areas, equipment, records and premises are appropriately secured r. Support vaccination clinics, recall programmes, screening activity and public-health campaigns as required s. Report significant events, near misses, safeguarding concerns, information breaches and other incidents promptly using practice procedures t. Follow lone-working and personal-safety procedures where applicable
